say:7:1422631007:1.text: This curse and our long exile is also not new information...
say:7:1422631007:1.source_cn: 背负着诅咒而流亡，这点也不是什么新鲜事……

say:8:1422631008:1.text: However, I must confess that the revelation of Misarte herself casting this curse was quite surprising.

choice_prompt:9:1422631008.text: However, I must confess that the revelation of Misarte herself casting this curse was quite surprising.

say:11:1422631010:0.text: However grievous their transgressions, this manner of divine retribution strikes me as... unorthodox, to say the least.

say:15:1422631013:0.text: To think they were condemned for protecting their homeland? No, this reeks of some deeper intrigue. The truth has always been buried beneath convenient lies.
say:15:1422631013:0.source_cn: 保卫家园却获得了惩罚吗？这其中必定有不为人知的隐情。

say:16:1422631014:0.text: If you ask me, a goddess in her righteous fury could have simply obliterated them outright or at the very least commanded her faithful to carry out the judgment.
say:16:1422631014:0.source_cn: 要我说，盛怒之下的神明，既没有直接毁灭他们，也没有命令...

say:18:1422631015:0.text: But instead, a vicious curse was cast...
say:18:1422631015:0.source_cn: 却设下了堪称恶毒的诅咒——

say:19:1422631016:0.text: Yes, why do it in such a roundabout way? If the gods wield power beyond mortal comprehension, why resort to something as petty as a curse? This reeks of deception.

say:20:1422631017:1.text: Indris, I have a task for you.

say:22:1422631019:1.text: This matter demands immediate attention. You need to personally venture into the Dark Forest and uncover the truth.
say:22:1422631019:1.source_cn: 放心，这次是正事。你需要前往薄暮丛林亲自调查。

say:23:1422631020:1.text: The curse was lifted from you, and you alone may walk the surface world... This makes your duty clear.
say:23:1422631020:1.source_cn: 曾经身负诅咒又得以解除，能够亲自踏上那片土地的——只有你了。
